deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 42` output filtered to the `Type` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; uses an overbroad Type grep and omits header byte, revision-dependent length and controller identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds raw version-aware validation but lowers capability for inputs.

original_test_intent: Validate that each intended management-controller host-interface structure is genuinely SMBIOS Type 42, structurally valid for the advertised revision and consistently mapped to the expected controller/interface after reboot.
original_method: Read raw structure headers, require type byte 42h, apply revision-specific minimum/layout validation, preserve handle/length and correlate each record with the approved BMC host-interface inventory before/after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected interfaces/revision policy and approves reboot; raw header validation is automated and read-only.
required_inputs: Advertised SMBIOS version and corresponding Type 42 layout/minimum-length policy
Raw parser, read-only interface inventory and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not reset, reconfigure, flash or power-cycle the BMC/host interface.
Read header byte by offset; never accept an arbitrary text line containing Type.
Apply the layout tied to the advertised SMBIOS revision before interpreting following bytes.
Stop on management/host health loss; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate raw type byte, handle/length and revision layout for every record, correlate expected interface identities and diff the complete set across reboot.
Report missing, duplicate, malformed, unexpected coexistence or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected interface/Type38 coexistence and revision-layout policy plus reboot recovery.
Interpret OEM-only records and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient: grep for Type is unscoped and cannot prove the structure header, version-specific length or interface ownership.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw Type 42 and SMBIOS entry-point data; emit handle/header type/length/layout version/controller-interface mapping and pre/post set diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type identity scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no controller action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse header byte 00h as 42h, validate the record under the advertised SMBIOS revision, map it to the approved management host interface and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems expected to publish SMBIOS Type 42 Management Controller Host Interface.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS entry-point, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and interface-inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 42 header and revision-specific layout definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces broad text grep with raw header, length/layout and controller-identity validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects unrelated Type text, malformed/truncated layouts, missing/duplicate records and interface-set drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected interface map and version policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Presence of a valid Type 42 record does not prove transport functionality; this case validates structure identity and declared mapping only.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define expected Type 38 coexistence, OEM records and interface count, but cannot reinterpret a non-42h header as Type 42 or use a mismatched layout.
expected_evidence: Approved management interface map, SMBIOS revision/layout and coexistence policy
Pre-reboot entry-point/version and complete raw Type 42 headers/handles/lengths
Version-aware structural results and controller/interface mapping
Statement that no BMC/interface configuration changed
Approved reboot/management health record and post-reboot record-set diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names the structure Type field; raw header validation is the faithful implementation despite the overbroad source command.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Header/layout/mapping validation is fully automatable after approved version and interface inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces unsafe broad grep with raw header, revision layout and interface identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its version/coexistence safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates spec/interface/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents unrelated formatted text from being accepted as evidence that the raw SMBIOS structure header is Type 42.
independent_technical_reasoning: Structure identity is a byte-level invariant governed by the advertised SMBIOS layout; it cannot be established from a human-readable word search.
